services.name: Weather Collector (Berlin) v2 -- Multi-source ingestion
services.description: Updated Berlin collector that ingests from several weather data providers concurrently instead of one, heavier CPU footprint than C2. Initially deployed alongside C2 on the same node it replaces, before any reconfiguration.

services.name: Weather Forecaster (Berlin, Cloud) v2 -- Ensemble model
services.description: Updated cloud Berlin forecaster that runs a multi-member ensemble model instead of a single model, heavier RAM footprint than F2. Initially deployed alongside F2 on the same node it replaces, before any reconfiguration.
